capabilities: Download remote images from the current note via a command palette command
Process every Markdown note in a folder recursively via right-click
Save images under the vault's attachment folder nested by note path
Rewrite remote URLs in note bodies and frontmatter to local paths
Report per-file download errors and summary notices
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian notes can reference remote images that break if the source changes or disappears, and downloading and relinking them by hand is tedious.
summary: Image downloader that saves remote images from a note or folder into the vault's attachment folder and rewrites the URLs to the local copies.
